cpcv.evaluation: CPCV, cross-fitted calibration per path (earlier groups only), pipeline threshold

reading_rule.feature: continue if the pooled out-of-fold AUC >= 0.53 with a weekly-block bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0.5, at least 1,000 candidates scored out of fold, and the model-filtered (cross-fitted, break-even + margin) trades have net mean R > 0; stop if the AUC < 0.52 (the screened features carry no information for this label: keep them as risk and cost filters only); otherwise inconclusive. Survivor unit: survivors are features: individual features whose fold frequency reaches the threshold in >= the stability share of folds; at most five go forward, and every later trial of one uses n_trials_effective (registry trials + features screened) in its deflated Sharpe, and must also pass the holdout rule before promotion. The design's gates are reported; a discovery is never promoted.
reading_rule.group: continue if the pooled out-of-fold AUC >= 0.53 with a weekly-block bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0.5, at least 1,000 candidates scored out of fold, and the model-filtered (cross-fitted, break-even + margin) trades have net mean R > 0; stop if the AUC < 0.52 (the screened features carry no information for this label: keep them as risk and cost filters only); otherwise inconclusive. Survivor unit: survivors are whole groups: groups whose fold frequency (joint permutation importance in the top groups) reaches the threshold in >= the stability share of folds; at most five go forward as whole groups, and every later trial of one uses n_trials_effective (registry trials + groups screened) in its deflated Sharpe, and must also pass the holdout rule before promotion. The design's gates are reported; a discovery is never promoted.
